findings.defect: The solver reads RANG_SOLVE_OPTIONS inside every solve; no CLI or campaign receipt records it, nor RANG_GRIDDER_DEVICE, RANG_GRIDDER_GPU_PRECISION, RANG_DF1_LIB or RANG_C1_LIB.
findings.failure: A shell with RANG_SOLVE_OPTIONS=qp_weights=transposed runs a campaign; the gains differ and the receipt looks like the archived default.
findings.fix: One registry of result-affecting RANG_* variables recorded in every receipt; solver options passed as an argument instead of the process environment.

findings.defect: ROOT = parents[2] is the checkout only for an editable install; for a wheel it is <venv>/lib/python3.X.
findings.failure: Receipts record the HEAD of any git repository around the venv; source_receipts raises FileNotFoundError.
findings.fix: Accept ROOT only when it holds the three manifests; otherwise commit null plus distribution version and extension SHA256; hash the installed package.

findings.defect: 2-D string-array keywords are flattened in Fortran order with a reversed shape; python-casacore 3.8.1 and the numeric path use C order.
findings.failure: [[a,b,c],[d,e,f]] is stored a,d,b,e,c,f instead of a,b,c,d,e,f.
findings.fix: arr.reshape(-1) (C order) and a 2-D string keyword in the oracle tests.

findings.defect: Bindings pass pointers without length checks and accept F-contiguous arrays (docstring says non-contiguous arrays are refused); unchecked size products.
findings.failure: Direct rang._core calls: 11 doubles written past a 1-element split_stats; Fortran-ordered uvw read transposed with status 0. Not reachable through the shipped wrappers except W4R-05.
findings.fix: sized/sized_mut on every binding, a C-contiguity check in ptr/ptr_mut, checked_mul on the size products.

findings.defect: flag_rows does not check antenna1/antenna2/times against nrow (zip truncates) or corr_type against ncorr.
findings.failure: The kernel reads past the shorter buffers and flags from heap bytes without an error.
findings.fix: Validate every length in the wrapper (and in the binding, W4R-04).

findings.defect: The C1 closure and FS1 flux kernels build a standalone crate with cargo on first call although the extension already exports their C symbols.
findings.failure: From the wheel both raise RuntimeError (no checkout); pytest builds core/target/c1-standalone and fs1-standalone; contradicts README 'nothing runs Cargo at a kernel call'.
findings.fix: PyO3 closure_scores and fluxstd_eval; wrappers call them; delete the standalone builders; verify C1 and FS1 archives.

findings.defect: Linux-only OS classifier though Windows and macOS wheels are built and tested; no Python version classifiers; only a Repository URL; relative logo and links break on PyPI.
findings.failure: PyPI page claims Linux only, with a broken logo and dead links; twine check passes.
findings.fix: Classifiers, Documentation and Issues URLs, absolute README URLs or a PyPI README.

findings.defect: Zarr ingest never checks .zarray order, hard-codes row-column dtypes, and core_fetch lacks the out-of-order block fallback of core_zarr.read_rows.
findings.failure: An F-order store or a different row dtype would be misread silently; out-of-order chunks fail instead of falling back. Latent: all 400 archived .zarray files are order C with matching dtypes.
findings.fix: Assert order and dtypes; one shared block-table helper with the fallback.

findings.defect: decode_span_rows does not verify that every requested row is covered by the decoded blocks; rang_core_fluxstd_eval has no catch_unwind.
findings.failure: Uncovered rows keep the caller's np.empty bytes with status 0 (wrappers always cover them); a panic aborts the process.
findings.fix: Return 1 for an uncovered row; wrap fluxstd_eval in catch_unwind.

findings.defect: 73 read_text() and about 29 write_text( calls without encoding in python/rang; CI sets PYTHONUTF8=1 and cannot see it.
findings.failure: Non-ASCII sky models or table.info readmes are mis-decoded or raise on a stock Windows Python before 3.15.
findings.fix: encoding='utf-8' (and newline='\n' for hashed files), a lint test, one CI job without PYTHONUTF8.

findings.defect: 13 tracked CRLF files, including the packaged python/rang/notebook/science.py; X1's .gitattributes never added.
findings.failure: Windows clones without core.autocrlf=false hash and format differently.
findings.fix: Add .gitattributes (* text=auto eol=lf, binaries) and renormalise.

findings.defect: No tag-equals-version check before release and publish; no CHANGELOG; Node 20 actions deprecated.
findings.failure: A tag without the version bump runs release and a failing publish.
findings.fix: Version-check step, CHANGELOG.md with --notes-file, bump the actions.

findings.defect: The sdist packs the whole tree (1,010 entries, 5.4 MB) including research/ with CC BY-NC-derived statistics and history/.
findings.failure: A GPL-3.0 sdist on PyPI redistributes CC BY-NC-derived numbers and frozen history; a licence ambiguity.

findings.defect: The check never builds, lints or tests the gpu feature.
findings.failure: A change that breaks core/src/gpu passes rang-core check (today clippy --all-features and cargo test --features gpu pass).

findings.defect: Dead fallbacks: a P5 ctypes branch naming core_fetch.CorrectInputs and p5_library (both gone) and the wgridder ctypes/standalone path.
findings.failure: Unreachable today; AttributeError or a cargo build if reached.

findings.defect: Statements the tree no longer matches (active experiment, wheel platforms, masks location, nothing runs Cargo, supported hosts, macOS jobs, contiguity, ctypes header).
findings.failure: Readers and new sessions start from stale rules.
findings.fix: Edits listed in the report's Documentation drift table.
